thresholds.description: Regression floors for the deterministic offline golden evaluator. v2 removes the heading-compliance gate (section_presence_rate) that contradicted the adaptive-synthesis contract; structural shape is scored as an informational metric and process cleanliness is gated instead. Quality floors are recalibrated to the adaptive baseline.

calibration.rule: floor = measured_actual - margin (see per-metric note in the accompanying OFFLINE_EVAL_v1.md)
calibration.margin_policy: invariants: 0.0; rates: 0.05; means: ~10-15% below actual; quality/relevance: ~8 points / 0.05
